:::{#def-overfitting}
#### Overfitting

**Overfitting** occurs when a model fits the training data well
but predicts poorly for new observations.
It results from including too many predictors
relative to the effective sample size.

::: {.small .text-muted}
Source: the rme notes' [definition of overfitting](https://morrison-lab.github.io/rme/chapters/predictor-selection.html#def-overfitting).
:::

:::

::: notes
In @exr-overfitting,
the terms beyond degree 2 fit the 20 training cars more closely
but do not predict the 12 held-out cars better.
The effect is small here:
it is the beginning of overfitting, not a dramatic case.
:::
